info.title: menu-api
info.description: A restaurant menu API, loosely ported from the .NET Menu.API of the EvoMaster benchmark. It exists to be fuzzed: the multipart upload endpoints and the JSON Patch endpoints both fan out into many distinguishable status codes on purpose.

post.summary: Attach several pictures, described by a JSON part
post.description: File parts next to an object part that travels as its own application/json section, as the encoding block says. The caption count has to match the file count, which is a branch only a correctly serialised JSON part reaches.

400.description: A part is missing or unreadable, or the caption count does not match the file count

413.description: Too many files, or one of them too large

415.description: The metadata part did not arrive as application/json, or a file is not an accepted image type

422.description: A file's bytes do not match its extension

post.summary: Upload the allergen sheet of a dish, as a PDF
post.description: One file part pinned to application/pdf by the encoding block. It has to start with %PDF- and carry a %%EOF trailer near the end; a second upload replaces the first. Its twin is the category icon: same shape, but that one wants a PNG, whose signature a text-encoded body cannot carry and this one's can.

400.description: The sheet part is missing, empty or nameless

415.description: The sheet part did not arrive as application/pdf, or is not a .pdf file

422.description: No PDF header, or a header with no trailer

405.description: Method not supported on this path

post.description: A text/csv file part next to a boolean part. The CSV has the same format as src/main/resources/setup/dishes.csv, commas inside a description written as colons. With dryRun the document is parsed and checked but nothing is stored.

400.description: The CSV is not this format, or dryRun is not a boolean

409.description: A row names a category that does not exist

415.description: The csv part did not arrive as text/csv
